name: Tiendanube
description: Tiendanube para Claude hace que administrar tu tienda sea tan fácil como tener una conversación. Conecta tu tienda existente en segundos y chatea para crear productos, actualizar stock y precios, lanzar promociones y cupones, consultar pedidos recientes, ver datos de tus clientes, o revisar métodos de envío y pago — todo sin abrir el admin.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tiendanube to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tiendanube to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://admin-mcp.tiendanube.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tiendanube MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tiendanube lists 28 MCP tools, including assign_categories, bulk_delete_products, create_category, create_coupon, create_product, create_promotion, delete_category, delete_coupon, delete_product, delete_promotion, get_coupon_details, and get_free_shipping_promotions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tiendanube?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Tiendanube in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Tiendanube requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tiendanube is developed by Tiendanube. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
